div.div:
A failed upload or download is caught per action:
it is counted in SyncReport.failed / errors and the run
still ends in Completed. Failed is reached only when the
whole run throws (no folder, IPC error) — the report is
then failedSyncReport(message).

div.div:
Notation: rounded rectangle = state (do / … = activity while in the state, exit / … = action on leaving);
filled circle = initial pseudo-state; bull's-eye = final state; arrow = transition «event [guard] / action».
Colours: purple = synchronization, blue = folder picker dialog, green = completion, red = aborted run.
Watching (FolderWatcher, UC14a) exists in the desktop client only; the web client always returns to Idle.
